name: Christchurch

queries.query: site:linz.govt.nz Christchurch cadastral parcels property boundaries map API New Zealand
queries.result: Official discovery found Land Information New Zealand (Toitū Te Whenua) NZ Property Boundaries and Landonline parcel datasets, and the Christchurch City Council public Property ArcGIS service. The Council service exposes a public LandParcel polygon layer suitable for bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry retrieval.

queries.query: whenua Christchurch mapi whenua parcel boundaries Aotearoa
queries.result: Official Māori-language discovery located LINZ guidance referring to land blocks and the Te Waipounamu Māori Land Court district, while the current public parcel service itself is documented and served in English. The Christchurch City Council service remains the evidenced local public map/API route.

researchNote: A local Christchurch City Council public property map/API and official national LINZ cadastral sources were evidenced. The exact WUP point had zero intersecting LandParcel features; this is not evidence of citywide absence. Three nearby bounded polygons are retained in the accompanying sample with only canonical native LandParcelID values.
